result.title: CLEAR: Legible and Steerable Recommendation via Grounded Natural-Language Interests
result.summary: Modern recommenders keep learned preferences in representations people cannot inspect or change. We present CLEAR (Controllable and Legible End-to-end Architecture for Recommendation), an end-to-end system deployed at Meta and built around an editable natural-language interest layer. CLEAR makes a ranked subset of inferred interests readable and stores accepted additions and suppressions as authoritative preference state. Behavioral grounding maps each inferred interest back to supporting events in the user's own history. The resulting interest object is also a serving address: its label and profile-conditioned rewrites drive lexical retrieval, its supporting events seed behavioral retrieval, its projection queries an embedding index, and its stable identity supports ranking, attribution, and exposure control. A fresh user declaration may precede behavioral support, so it enters through the same serving identity and initially draws candidates from topical retrieval. Ranking makes those candidates competitive, while a delivery controller observes attributable exposure and replenishes underexposed interests. Direct user review found that users rated about 88.5% of displayed interests accurate. In an offline benchmark using a shared evaluation protocol, the Specialized 3B generator reached 0.3967 mean-user F1@10, compared with 0.3633 for Gemini 2.5 Pro and 0.1911 for the prior generator. For a newly declared interest, a user-randomized cumulative ablation measured same-day delivery losses of 8.7 percentage points for added-interest ranking terms, 11.1 for reserved top-slot insertion, and 13.7 for interest-conditioned candidate sourcing, conditional on the tested removal sequence. CLEAR components have operated in production for over one year; the system spans four surfaces on Instagram and Facebook, with an interest layer people can inspect, correct, and use to direct recommendations.

AI.brief_summary: CLEAR 在推荐系统中构建一个可读、可编辑的自然语言兴趣层，把推断出的兴趣映射回用户历史中的证据事件，并让该兴趣对象同时充当检索、排序、归因与曝光控制的统一服务地址。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「显式可读状态+证据接地+可人工增删的状态写入+基于归因的调控」思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的可解释呈现、视觉证据溯源与外部干预提供问题表述上的启发，但领域与视觉多模态推理相距较远，需核查其状态表示是否可迁移。
